title: Exactness of the explicit filtered homology maps
statement: For every abelian category $C$ [def-sp-abelian], cochain complex $K$ and decreasing filtration $F$, the explicitly defined maps $\alpha,f,g$ of [def-sp-filtered-homology-couple-data] have zero consecutive composites and are exact at every term: $\operatorname{im}f^{P,Q}=\ker\alpha^{P+2,Q-1}$, $\operatorname{im}g^{P,Q}=\ker f^{P,Q}$, and $\operatorname{im}\alpha^{P,Q}=\ker g^{P-1,Q+1}$. All comparisons include the integer-index equality transports fixed in that definition. No assertion about a derived couple or a quotient-page comparison is made.

source.place: Tags 012K and 011Q; homology long exact sequence of successive filtration steps

proof.text: The successive-step short complex is short exact by filteredStep_shortExact. Apply Mathlib ShortComplex.ShortExact.homology_exact₁, homology_exact₂, homology_exact₃ and δ_comp, comp_δ (Mathlib/Algebra/Homology/HomologySequence.lean, lines 295--325). The original inclusion-projection composite is zero, so functoriality of homology gives its zero composite. Transport the resulting three homology short complexes by eqToIso using the displayed integer identities, and apply ShortComplex.exact_iff_image_eq_kernel. This gives the six equations for the explicitly fixed maps.

lean.statement: theorem filteredHomologyCouple_exact (C : Type u) [Category.{v} C] [Abelian C] (K : CochainComplex C ℤ) (F : DecreasingFiltration K) : (∀ P Q, filteredHomologyF K F P Q ≫ filteredHomologyAlpha K F (P + 2) (Q - 1) = 0) ∧ (∀ P Q, filteredHomologyG K F P Q ≫ filteredHomologyF K F (P + (0 : ℕ)) (Q - (0 : ℕ)) = 0) ∧ (∀ P Q, filteredHomologyAlpha K F P Q ≫ filteredHomologyG K F (P - 1) (Q + 1) = 0) ∧ (∀ P Q, imageSubobject (filteredHomologyF K F P Q) = kernelSubobject (filteredHomologyAlpha K F (P + 2) (Q - 1))) ∧ (∀ P Q, imageSubobject (filteredHomologyG K F P Q) = kernelSubobject (filteredHomologyF K F (P + (0 : ℕ)) (Q - (0 : ℕ)))) ∧ (∀ P Q, imageSubobject (filteredHomologyAlpha K F P Q) = kernelSubobject (filteredHomologyG K F (P - 1) (Q + 1)))
